item: D44 built: the collector may not take the last pooled connections
key_paths: src/database/pool_reserve.py; src/database/session.py; src/scheduler/runner.py; src/config/memory_budget.py; src/monitoring/collect_perf.py; tests/test_pool_reserve.py; tests/test_pool_api_margin.py
summary: A reservation at checkout (D44 = a): ReservingQueuePool takes a counting slot for collector-role threads BEFORE the pool hands a connection out, so at most pool_total minus _API_MARGIN pooled connections are ever held by the collector and the API keeps the margin. Fetch fan-out is not capped and R26 stands; the ceiling is derived from the pool the memory budget already sizes from RAM. A holder never waits for a second slot (nested sessions would deadlock) and those checkouts are counted, not hidden. The medium tier now reports sufficient true with headroom equal to the margin, beside the unreserved figure. test_the_medium_tier_is_still_exhaustible_and_says_so flipped as its pinning note said.
